paragraphs.text: Obyra (oh-BEE-ruh or oh-BEYE-ruh) is a famed Faerie duelist and princess from Eldraine . She is one of the fae lord Talion 's daughters.
Obyra is considered the greatest duelist in Eldraine. She carries a magic rapier fashioned from a spindle of golden thread.
As a princess taken by a sleeping curse, Obyra is based on the titular character of " Sleeping Beauty ". Her spindle weapon and fairy attendants also serve as references to the fairytale.

Obyra is a daughter of the fae lord Talion and the princess of the High Fae. When the Wicked Slumber expanded to encapsulate the realm, she was afflicted by the curse. Her finely tuned sword-fighting instincts couldn't be suppressed, and she roamed Eldraine seeking other duelists even while asleep. Meanwhile, Obyra's attendants, Beauty, Song, and Blessing , tried to keep her out of trouble with whatever means necessary.
Obyra presumably awoke after the curse was broken.
